ProcessConfigFilterHover:
Data will be imported based on the values entered here. Regular expressions can be used.
For example, use
""   “abc” to search for items containing “abc” (partial match),
   “^abc” to find items starting with “abc”,
   “^abc$” for items matching “abc” (exact match),
   “ab|c” to search for items containing either “ab” or “c” (OR condition), and
   “^(?!test|abc).*” to find items starting something other than “test” or “abc”.
(“^” indicates that the next character is at the beginning, “$” indicates that the preceding character is at the end, and “|” means OR.
Note: The quotation marks are not needed when entering the values.)
HoverConversationFormulaMsg:
Transformation rule used to define how judgment results are displayed.
This is used in graphs and other visualizations.
When the data type is Judge, the formula (e.g., Pos=p0|p1, Neg=n1) is applied.

- p0: Value of the positive case in the raw data (e.g., "Pass")
- p1: Display value for the positive case (e.g., "OK")
- n1: Display value for the negative case (e.g., "NG")

Values that match p0 are transformed to p1;
all other values are transformed to n1 for display.
If no positive case exists (e.g., defect history data), set p0 to Null.
